scope: historical registry audit and exact Android reruns
frozen_records: Read-only inputs; never rewrite prior experiment results.
route_priority: other full-E2E rows with missing playable samples

measurement.cold: first generation in a fresh process
measurement.warm: at least three valid warm generations where the exact historical contract permits
measurement.rtf: synthesis wall time divided by actual decoded audio duration
measurement.memory: retain peak PSS when sampled and cumulative VmHWM/ru_maxrss semantics separately
measurement.threads: exact historical thread count; no substitution

comparison.material_difference_rule: Any output-duration, text, voice, seed/settings, provider, or protocol difference is flagged and does not silently replace the historical cell.
comparison.new_audio_review: not_reviewed until explicit Moritz route/sample verdict
